brief:
Arab League Secretary-General Nabil Fahmy affirmed the central role of UNRWA across its five operational areas, stating the agency has no alternative in providing health and education services to millions of Palestinian refugees, Shehab Wire reported. Fahmy's comments reflect the organization's assessment that no other entity currently delivers comparable humanitarian assistance to displaced Palestinians.

The Arab League secretary-general called on donor nations to maintain financial backing for the UN agency. UNRWA operates across multiple regions serving Palestinian refugee populations with critical medical and educational programs that millions depend on daily.
